name: Warrens

civilopediaText.text: In ExtraModMod Continued, Warrens produce one additional copy of each eligible living unit trained here. World units, national units, mechanical units, and nonliving units are excluded. This Unciv implementation uses hidden training promotions to spawn a matching second unit and transfer applicable training bonuses. Warrens' original +10% maintenance is not yet implemented; exact unit placement and crowded-city cases require testing.
